closureScope: All custom hybrid/deployment MJS/Python, both hybrid Solidity sources, wallet, package/lock files, and JS/CJS/MJS/JSON/NODE/WASM package runtime files checked against manifest. One unused node_modules/.bin CLI symlink is not a direct runtime payload; its resolved source target is frozen. Native artifacts and plan are included in the6243-file hash pass.
emptyRegularFilePolicy: Bridge permits zero-length regular files only under unchanged size/hash binding; empty JSON still fails JSON parsing.
scope: Read-only frozen manifest integrity/dependency coverage review; source file hashes are bindings, not a scientific acceptance claim.
